selected_forecast_authority.year_2_year_3: position-routed Forecast plus frozen M1a plus frozen two-prior-season consistency

year_1_scoring_verification.behavior: Both Year-1 coordinates are derived directly from the same immutable raw observations. League-facing Year 1 is recalculated under connected league rules; standard/non-PPR is independently derived for frozen-model use.

details: The loader embeds frozen_i1_h12.json and frozen_i1_h3.json from the private-beta activation bundle.
compose_live_intrinsic_calendar receives LeagueScoringNormalizedI1Predictor wrappers around those legacy I1 artifacts.
The selected routed A2+C+D/A2+D Forecast with M1a and two-prior consistency is not wired into the PR.

recovered_selected_candidate_evidence.warning: The recovered board is durable evidence for the September 18 live Year-1 coordinate only. It is not a valid output from the September 10 preseason standard coordinate.

exact_missing_dependencies: The fitted current-cutoff routed probability estimator artifacts for QB A2+C+D and RB/WR/TE A2+D, including DictVectorizer feature state and all LogisticRegression coefficients/intercepts for persistence and ordered positive-state thresholds.
A deployment-grade serialization of the frozen M1a and two-prior conditional-production transforms/coefficients attached to the selected routed estimator.
A governed replacement identity/history materialization coordinate aligned to the preserved preseason 335-player population, including Malik Davis rather than Roman Wilson.
A row-complete Y2/Y3 selected-candidate board produced from the preserved preseason standard/non-PPR coordinate, or sufficient frozen estimator state to reproduce that board without fitting.
prohibited_substitutions: Do not use the recovered September 18 live-coordinate Y2/Y3 board as if it came from the preseason coordinate.
Do not refit or reconstruct the routed estimator.
Do not substitute PR #147's legacy embedded I1 path.
Do not estimate Year 1 through a scoring multiplier.
Do not tune to named current players.
